final: WITH project_counts AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanspatial GROUP BY arcref), totals AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM project_counts), paired AS (SELECT p.record_count, CAST(p.record_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS count_ratio FROM project_counts AS p CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count FROM paired), kept AS (SELECT p.record_count, p.count_ratio, p.record_count - a.average_count AS count_difference FROM paired AS p CROSS JOIN averages AS a WHERE a.average_count IS NOT NULL AND p.record_count > a.average_count) SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count, AVG(count_ratio) AS average_count_to_total_ratio, AVG(count_difference) AS average_difference FROM kept
